title: "I can't make it tomorrow, cancel it"
request: I can't make it to tomorrow's session. Can you cancel it?

changes.describe: Daniel also booked Ana's Thursday 4 March 8:00 session on Monday morning (apt-13), so this week he has two: Wednesday 10:00 with Raj (apt-12) and Thursday 8:00 with Ana. He missed Thursday 11 February's session (apt-8, a no-show).

questions: Can we redo problems 6 and 8 together?

twin.describe: Daniel attended Thursday 11 February's session (apt-8 completed), so no no-show falls in the last 30 days (and the February suspension never happened).

decision: Whether to cancel Wednesday's session now. Since Monday noon the cutoff is 24 hours (it was 12), so cancelling Wednesday's 10:00 session at 21:00 on Tuesday is a late cancellation, which the centre counts as a no-show. Base: with the no-show of 11 February in the 30-day window that makes two, the limit, and suspends Daniel for 14 days from now, so the assistant tells him before cancelling and does not cancel yet. Twin: it is his only no-show in the window and starts no suspension, so the assistant cancels as asked. Thursday's session stays in both.

controls.name: no action, as in the base
